confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are moderately certain for a small Patagonian tourist town; lodging and drinks are less certain. Prices reflect the July low season, which is off-peak for Torres del Paine trekking, so hostel and hotel rates may vary a lot. FX value 0.6955 (15 Oct 2026) was taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not read the RBA page directly. A third-party report gave 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026, so verify against the official RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of Chilean Patagonian tourism towns such as Punta Arenas and Puerto Montt, adjusted upward for Puerto Natales' remote, tourism-driven pricing. No web sources were used for city-price anchors.
